title: Pharmacy Services Schedule: Rush Packaging Charge for Late Physician's Reports
content:
When the physician's report reaches pharmacy services close to arrival, the medication of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement must be packed on a rush basis.

**Charge.** The rush packaging charge is thirty dollars (30.00) when the physician's report on file is dated five or fewer days (5 or fewer) before the planned arrival date, fifteen dollars (15.00) when it is dated six to ten days (6 to 10) before, and nothing otherwise.

**Counting.** The days are the planned arrival date less the date of the physician's report recorded on the stay (its health documents date), in calendar days.

**How it enters the charge.** The rush packaging charge is added to the medication setup charge as a flat amount.

| Physician's report dated before the planned arrival date | Rush packaging charge |
|---|---|
| 5 days or fewer | 30.00 |
| 6 to 10 days | 15.00 |
| 11 days or more | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, planned arrival 20 May)

| Report dated | Days before arrival | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 15 May | 5 | 30.00 |
| 14 May | 6 | 15.00 |
| 10 May | 10 | 15.00 |
| 9 May | 11 | Nothing |
